name: Paused Deadlift
instructions: Set up as for a conventional deadlift, with the bar over the middle of your feet and a grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar off the floor until it is just below your knees.
Hold this position for 1 to 3 seconds. Keep your back flat and the bar close to your legs.
Stand up to full lockout with your hips and knees straight.
Lower the bar to the floor under control, and repeat.
